mapper.select: SELECT ISNULL(A.DEALER_CD,'') AS DEALER_CD , ISNULL(A.HIS_SEQ ,'') AS HIS_SEQ , ISNULL(A.REMARK ,'') AS REMARK , ISNULL(A.USE_YN ,'') AS USE_YN , ISNULL(A.ENT_DT ,'') AS ENT_DT , CASE WHEN TRY_PARSE(A.ENT_ID AS NUMERIC) IS NULL THEN A.ENT_ID ELSE DBO.FN_USRNM(A.ENT_ID) END AS ENT_ID , ISNULL(A.MFY_DT ,'') AS MFY_DT , CASE WHEN TRY_PARSE(A.MFY_ID AS NUMERIC) IS NULL THEN A.MFY_ID ELSE DBO.FN_USRNM(A.MFY_ID) END AS MFY_ID FROM ACC_DEALER_HISTORY A WHERE A.DEALER_CD = #{DEALER_CD} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
